channel.title: DevFocus - 开发者聚焦
channel.description: 每日自动整理的开发者资讯：AI 热榜、GitHub 趋势、技术新闻

item.title: [zhihu] 三大运营商停止第三方互联网渠道号卡办理，低价大流量卡将集体退场，出于哪些考量？对普通消费者有什么影响？
item.description: China's three major telecom operators have shut down third-party internet channels for new SIM card registrations, eliminating cheap high-data plans sold through live streams and e-commerce platforms. The move targets irregular sales, tighter real-name rules, and anti-fraud enforcement, while easing price competition. Regular users will have to rely on official apps or brick-and-mortar stores, where low-cost high-volume plans will be harder to get.

item.title: [zhihu] 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
item.description: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

item.title: [zhihu] DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
item.description: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

item.title: [zhihu] 自己暂时没有开车需求，却不断被父母催着考驾照，有必要为了「以后总会用到」现在就学吗？
item.description: A Zhihu thread explores whether to learn driving now even when you don't need it, just because parents push it. Top answers weigh the time and money spent against a future that may never come; the consensus is to wait until you actually need a license. Others point out practical cases like school or emergencies. Helpful for anyone facing family pressure.

item.title: [zhihu] 为什么 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练如此有效？
item.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

item.title: [zhihu] DeepSeek V4 flash 上线，相较 Kimi K3 各有哪些优劣？现版本大模型中你的选择是啥？
item.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash has launched with a focus on low latency and reduced inference costs; official benchmarks put it near Kimi K3, while K3 retains an edge in long-context comprehension and complex reasoning. Flash suits high-frequency, cost-sensitive applications, whereas K3 fits deep-analysis or multi-step workflows. Developers should evaluate context windows, pricing, and their actual workload rather than relying solely on leaderboards.

item.title: [zhihu] 如何看待 OpenAI 下一代模型 Astra 大量解决数学猜想？
item.description: OpenAI's next-generation model, codenamed Astra, is reported to have made significant progress on several mathematical conjectures, but no paper or reproducible details have surfaced yet. If confirmed, it could push large language models into automated reasoning and formal proof. AI researchers should watch for follow-up evidence.

item.title: [zhihu] 字节系在移动互联网用户时长的占比升至 40.1%，正式超越腾讯系的 29.7%，你怎么看？
item.description: ByteDance's share of China's mobile internet user time reached 40.1%, surpassing Tencent's 29.7% for the first time, according to QuestMobile. The growth is driven by short-video apps and recommendation feeds, while Tencent relies on WeChat's video channels. This trend offers developers insight into content distribution and platform competition.

item.title: [zhihu] 最近内存、存储甚至显卡涨价，一个个都说自己要当等等党，等到 2040 年能成功吗？
item.description: RAM, storage, and GPU prices are rising due to AI server demand and factory capacity allocation, creating a supply-demand gap unlikely to ease soon. Waiting until 2040 for a drop is just a meme. DIY builders and cloud users should instead track HBM capacity and advanced-node availability.

item.title: [zhihu] 都说 KMP 算法效率高，现实中真没看到哪些领域用到的最多？
item.description: KMP is widely embedded in text editors, regex engines, search indexing, and bioinformatics for substring matching, though rarely written by hand. Its prefix-function idea shapes many low-level tools. Developers working on large-scale text processing can still benefit from understanding KMP for performance tuning.

item.title: [36kr] 9点1氪丨马斯克回应特斯拉剥离中国业务；国内航线燃油附加费将再次下调；中国最高薪本科专业易主
item.description: This is 36Kr’s daily morning briefing, featuring three key stories: Musk’s response to rumors about Tesla splitting off its China business, another cut in domestic flight fuel surcharges, and a change in the highest-paid undergraduate major. It’s a quick read for anyone who wants to stay informed on business news in a few minutes.

item.title: [36kr] 如何将你对学习的热爱转化为一人公司
item.description: The article lays out a concrete path for turning a love of learning into a solo business: keep sharing what you learn on a specific topic to build trust, then monetize through courses or consulting. It’s aimed at independent creators who want to make money from their self-directed learning.

item.title: [36kr] 突发，谷歌地球紧急撤回Nano Banana 2生图功能
item.description: Google Earth pulled its Nano Banana 2 image-generation feature shortly after launch following unexpected issues, with no official reason given yet. Rollbacks like this are often linked to content safety or output quality, so users and developers should watch for a follow-up explanation.

item.title: [36kr] 奥特曼承认：高估了AI抢饭碗！黄仁勋：失业论完全搞反了
item.description: Discussing AI's impact on jobs, Sam Altman admitted the threat of mass unemployment is exaggerated, while Jensen Huang dismissed the jobs-apocalypse narrative, arguing AI will amplify human skills and create more roles. Despite their different tones, both imply AI is currently more of an aid than a replacement.

item.title: [36kr] AI来了，大厂中层不好混了
item.description: As AI takes over coordination duties like information consolidation and progress tracking, big tech companies are cutting middle-management layers. Managers who relied on relaying messages between teams are now layoff targets. For engineers, this means the individual contributor track gains value — promotion no longer requires managing people, and technical expertise alone can pay off.

item.title: [36kr] 苹果的5万亿美元时刻：最强财报，最弱AI
item.description: Apple posted record holiday-quarter results, with revenue and margins beating expectations, pushing its market cap above $5 trillion for the first time. However, its AI efforts remain a clear weakness: Apple Intelligence lags rivals like Microsoft and Google in both rollout and usability, and investors are starting to question the company's underwhelming AI investment. Developers should expect limited platform AI capability in the near term.

item.title: [36kr] 暴增389%，DeepSeek卷到白菜价，这家公司却靠卖Token赚翻了
item.description: As DeepSeek pushes API prices down to rock-bottom levels, one vendor saw revenue explode 389% by reselling tokens. Instead of competing on model quality, it packages cheap models into enterprise offerings, charging for integration and maintenance. The takeaway: raw model access is commoditized; the money is in the service layer.

item.title: [36kr] 上海雪花膏，破产了
item.description: The century-old manufacturer behind Shanghai's iconic snow cream jars has filed for bankruptcy. The heritage beauty brand failed to modernize its formulations and marketing, losing ground to foreign brands and new domestic rivals. It's a striking case study in how legacy Chinese consumer brands are being squeezed out of a fast-moving market.

item.title: [36kr] 少投入不是苹果的免死金牌
item.description: Commentary argues that Apple's deliberately low AI spending won't shield it from competitive pressure. Despite strong services growth, underwhelming Apple Intelligence could dampen iPhone upgrade demand and weaken ecosystem lock-in. It's a reminder that Apple's solid fundamentals don't excuse its growing AI gap — a long-term risk investors should weigh.

item.title: [36kr] 刚刚，OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光！
item.description: OpenAI has revealed Astra, a new model with real-time voice dialogue and multimodal understanding that can identify objects in video and respond on the fly. It's likely to be integrated into ChatGPT in a future release, serving as an upgrade over GPT-4o. For AI developers, this signals that building real-time interactive applications is about to get significantly easier.

item.title: [infoq] 翁荔被爆重返OpenAI！两天前因身体原因从Thinking Machines Lab离职
item.description: Weng Li, a prominent safety researcher who previously led OpenAI's safety work, is reportedly returning to OpenAI just two days after leaving Thinking Machines Lab citing health reasons. The move signals potential shifts in OpenAI's safety team priorities and may interest those tracking AI governance.

item.title: [infoq] 微软、Meta 同日交财报：小扎把现金流烧到只剩7.84亿美元，纳德拉靠 Azure 赚疯了
item.description: Meta's latest earnings revealed free cash flow shrank to just $784 million, hit by soaring AI infrastructure spending, while Microsoft posted strong Azure growth the same day. The contrast underscores how AI capex is now reshaping Big Tech financials, a key signal for investors.

item.title: [infoq] AI浪潮中，如何定义自己的“确定性”之旅？
item.description: As AI transforms every industry, many feel anxious about finding clarity in the chaos. This article explores the concept of "certainty" and suggests that both companies and individuals should anchor on core competencies and long-term goals, rather than chasing every trend. It advocates continuous learning and iteration to carve out a stable development path amid rapid technological change. By focusing on value judgment and consistent action, readers can navigate the AI wave with more confidence.

Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private.

item.title: [hackernews] The coolest use for the Vision Pro
item.description: A Hacker News thread argues the Vision Pro's coolest use is as a portable multi-monitor workstation: pair it with a Mac and project several virtual displays for coding or design, not immersive video. Developers in the comments mostly agree that productivity beats entertainment here, despite complaints about comfort and battery. Worth reading if you're evaluating Apple's spatial computer.

item.title: [hackernews] 7.1 Earthquake in Japan
item.description: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake shook Japan with strong tremors, but did not trigger a major tsunami. The event once again underscores the importance of earthquake early warning systems and Japan's leadership in disaster prevention technology. For the tech industry, it also serves as a real-world test of various communication and monitoring devices.

The author emphasizes that all tips have been verified in practice, making this resource valuable for any developer looking to get the most out of their AI coding assistant.

item.title: [hackernews] Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
item.description: This article warns that cheap streaming sticks come with hidden costs: system files eat available storage, OS updates have a limited lifespan, and home screens show ads. It compares Roku, Fire TV, and Google TV on long-term experience, arguing that a low upfront price doesn't mean low total ownership. A must-read before picking a living-room device.

It targets developers and small teams who prefer a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to heavier project management suites. The project emphasizes adapting to user workflows rather than forcing users to adapt to the tool.

item.title: [hackernews] Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
item.description: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

item.title: [hackernews] The session you cannot take with you
item.description: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

item.title: [hackernews] KOReader

Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.
